origin.description: Return the minimum collation rank of each string.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: Locale used for comparisons. The default is "en" so English collation is the same on every platform.

arguments.name: numeric
arguments.text: TRUE ranks digit runs as numbers. FALSE, the default, ranks them as text.
Further collator settings, passed to stringi::stri_opts_collator().

origin.details: Tied strings share the smaller rank. A missing string stays missing and does not take a rank. The default locale is English.
origin.value: An integer vector the same length as x. NA where x is missing.

translation.description: Return the minimum collation rank of each string.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A string, NA, a number, or a list of those. None is an empty result.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: Locale used for comparisons. The default is "en".

arguments.name: numeric
arguments.text: True ranks digit runs as numbers. False ranks them as text.

translation.details: Calls stri_rank. Tied strings share the smaller rank. A missing string stays NA. The default locale is English.
translation.value: A list of integers the same length as x. NA is stringi._na.NA.
